text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: spike in 5xx from control-plane dependencies (billing/config/org-lookup). Auto-created incident #INC-2026-45. Paging oncall now.

incident-bot: Symptoms: ~10-30% 5xx on /v1/* routes, elevated gateway timeouts (504) and 502s. Affected region: us-west-2 primarily. Probable upstream: org-lookup and billing-service timeouts.

sara (oncall): just saw the alert on my phone, joining. Can someone drop recent logs + request IDs? :eyes:

jamal: grabbing logs now, looks like auth calls to org-lookup are timing out and the gateway is surfacing 502s. Sample from logs:
```
[2026-03-14T02:03:11Z] gateway -> upstream org-lookup timeout (500ms)  -> 502
[2026-03-14T02:03:12Z] billing-service 504 gateway_timeout order=xyz123
[2026-03-14T02:03:12Z] trace_id=abcd1234 path=/v1/models customer_id=acct_9c3
```

priya: confirming dashboard: error rate jumped at 02:02 UTC. 5xx rate peaked at 22% for prod-us-west-2 for last 5m. Upstream latency for org-lookup median -> 850ms (target 100ms).

alex: last deploy? Any config pushes in the last hour?

platform-ops: there was a config push to billing routing ~01:50 UTC (canary) that was promoted at 01:58. Rolling back to previous routing for billing in progress (rollback initiated).

sara (oncall): good. Jamal/priya do we have a safe mitigation we can apply quickly? Can we fail-open org-lookup to cached mapping or route to the backup cluster?

jamal: we have cached org mappings in redis in the control-plane. Quick mitigation options:
- enable cached fallback for org-lookup (will return last-known mapping for 95% of calls)
- increase upstream timeout for gateway to 2s (temporary)
- route billing traffic to secondary cluster (if healthy)

priya: telemetry suggests cached fallback will reduce 5xx by ~60% w/o impacting correctness much for reads. Writes to billing still risky.

sara (oncall): do cached fallback now. Jamal can you run the toggle? I'll coordinate rollback for billing routing.

jamal: toggling cached fallback in progress...
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/admin/toggles/org_lookup_fallback -d '{"enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer token'
```

jamal: fallback enabled. Observability note: live counts show 5xx dropping from 22% -> 8% in the last 60s.

maria (support): starting customer-impact message. Which customers are hitting errors? Any high-traffic customers affected?

priya: preliminary list: acct_9c3, acct_77b (realtime embedding requests), acct_enterprise_alpha (sporadic). We'll export request ids and examples for support.

support-bot: Slack escalation: sending status page update template to #status-updates for review.

alex: billing routing rollback completed at 02:08 UTC. Re-checking billing-service health... still sporadic 5xx but lower.

platform-ops: we've also opened a support ticket with infra provider for increased latency in us-west-2 between app-nodes and redis. Investigating host-level network flaps.

sara (oncall): next: prepare postmortem skeleton, track timeline, customers, mitigations. Jamal can you capture the specific toggles + command log? Priya capture graphs (error rate, latency, traffic by route). Maria compile customer-facing note draft.

jamal: copying command log to incident artifact bucket now.
```
aws s3 cp /var/logs/incident/1769800000-toggle.log s3://incidents/1769800000/toggle.log
```

priya: attaching quick charts: error_rate.png, org_lookup_latency.png (uploaded to incident channel thread).

maria (support): customer note draft: "We experienced elevated errors caused by timeouts to an internal control-plane dependency. A cached fallback was enabled which restored most request patterns. Production impact reduced at 02:04 UTC; full resolution ongoing. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Ping me with any changes. :+1:

sara (oncall): good. Jamal, once platform-ops confirms network is stable, plan to remove fallback and revalidate with canary traffic. If rollback of fallback causes spike, we'll pause and re-evaluate.

platform-ops: infra provider confirmed transient network packet loss between two racks in us-west-2 at 01:58-02:10 UTC. They mitigated underlying hardware, we see improvements in host-level metrics at ~02:12.

jamal: gradation: post-mitigation metrics: 5xx down to 1.5% across regions; org-lookup p50 back to 120ms. Will run a controlled disable of fallback at 02:30 and monitor.

sara (oncall): handing off to jamal for night coverage. I'm going offline for sleep shift. Jamal please take primary ownership, update status doc, and escalate to eng-sre if anything re-surges.

jamal: taking over. On-call handoff: I have access to toggles, logs, and incident artifacts. Contact me via @jamal or pager if it spikes.

maria (support): I've sent initial customer communications to affected accounts and created follow-ups for any tickets that came in. Will keep updating.

support-bot: Incident #INC-2026-45 created and flagged P1. Postmortem template assigned to sara (oncall) and jamal.

jamal: disabling fallback now in 3,2,1...
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/admin/toggles/org_lookup_fallback -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer token'
```

jamal: fallback disabled at 02:31 UTC. Monitoring: no regression in error rate in the last 5m. p50 org_lookup ~130ms.

sara (oncall): nice work team. We'll keep the incident open until we have RCA from infra provider and follow-up actions listed (improve network resilience, add better retry/backoff, more aggressive circuit-breaker metrics, and a scheduled runbook update).

jamal: noted. Logging follow-ups: add a synthetic canary hitting org-lookup every 30s and an alert if p50 > 300ms for 3m.

priya: adding those to observability backlog and will file the alert PR.

maria (support): closing loop with customers that reported errors earlier. Putting final notice on status page after RCA confirmed.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded -> monitoring. P1 -> lowered to P2 for doc/RCA work.

jamal: last check 02:56 UTC: 5xx < 1.2% across zones, org-lookup latency stable. I'll keep monitoring for the next 2 hours then hand back to day shift.

sara (oncall): thanks all, good handoff.

-- end of thread --
